Must Read: ELM-CNL students only need to take a General Chemistry course to qualify for the program.


Grading

You must achieve a cumulative GPA exceeding 3.0 across the following courses, with a minimum grade of \"C\" in each:

  • BIOL 230: Human Anatomy with laboratory
  • BIOL 270: Human Physiology
  • BIOL 280: Microbiology for the Healthcare Professions
  • CHEM 220: Chemistry for the Healthcare Professions
  • PSYC 200: Introduction to Psychology
  • SOC 200: Introduction to Sociology

Additionally, these courses require a minimum grade of \"C\" in each:

  • ENG 101: English Composition
  • COM 180: Speech and Rhetoric
  • STAT 250: Introductory Statistics for the Healthcare Professions

Your combined English composition and communication coursework (like ENG 101 and COM 180) must total at least 6 semester credit hours.

Strongly Preferred

While not mandatory, intermediate-level Spanish language competency is strongly preferred. You are also highly encouraged to take LANG 241, Medical Spanish for the Healthcare Professions, during your enrollment at Pepperdine, in addition to the ELM curriculum.
